integrity: The derivative identity and linear-block determinants are derived directly from the printed differential equations and replayed symbolically. Global attraction is proved using boundedness, an exact Lyapunov identity, LaSalle invariance, and the Hurwitz plant subsystem; the critical-case stability argument uses uniform infected-state control and variation of constants.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the uncontrolled autonomous SIXP model on nonnegative data with \(S+I>0\). It does not classify the endemic equilibrium, convergence rates, or the optimal-control problem. Indexed searches did not reveal same-system coverage of the critical global threshold; full-text access to the 2021 three-state predecessor was incomplete.
title: Exact closed extinction threshold for the SIXP leaf-brown-spot model
